notes: Session A of the LUM-1319 cross-process proof. Run it with `--home /tmp/lum1319/home` and then run lum1319-history-session-b.json against the SAME --home: the second process is what proves the history survived the first one.
Each panel submits one prompt through the real Enter path, so the append happens in the composer's own submit hook (`Editor::push_history_entry` → `HistoryStore::append`).
`<C-d>` exits gracefully so the run has a real shutdown before session B starts.
Evidence on disk after the run: `$HOME/.pi/agent/history.jsonl`, one JSON row per prompt, mode 0600.
